easingExplanation: CSS default when timing-function is omitted: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)
behavior: Movement and background-color interpolation start together and reverse together.
adaptation: Only transform and background-color transitions. Existing Figma dimensions, positions, palettes, native semantics, danger and focus ring retained. Reference shadows, ripple, hover/active paints and dimensions excluded. No opacity change exists on our track, so only its changing background is animated.
